description: Equipment lease vs buy (NPV) — Equipment lease-versus-buy decision by NPV of after-tax costs, discounted at the after-tax cost of debt. Give price, months (lease term) and leasePayment (monthly); optional rate (loan APR, default 8), taxRate (default 21), residual (expected resale value at term end), maintenance (monthly cost if you buy), leaseUpfront, advance (payments in advance, default true), depreciation (macrs3, macrs5 default, macrs7, macrs10, sl with life=, or bonus) and purchaseOption. Returns PV cost to buy and to lease, net advantage of leasing, LEASE/BUY decision, breakeven lease payment, implied lease rate, depreciation tax shields by year and after-tax residual with recapture. Offline, instant. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_lease_vs_buy
